title: people-ops recruiting coordinator daily scratchpad - 2026-03-19
content:
TODAY (2026-03-19) - quick scratchpad

Top priorities:
- Follow up: Priya R. (Sr. SWE) - still waiting on take-home feedback from Eng lead. Send 1-line reminder + new deadline (Fri EOD).
- Confirm panel: PM interview for Marcos L. at 11:00 PT — need to lock Aaron + Jin 10:30–12:00. If Jin busy, route to SRE rotation.
- Send calendar invites: 3 candidate slots (see times below). Make sure invites include Zoom + candidate interview kit link.
- Offer packet draft: start comp numbers for L5 PM req — confirm comp band with Ben (hiring mgr) before sending.

Schedule (blocks + quick ops):
- 08:45 — inbox triage (resume pings, candidate replies)
- 09:15 — call w/ Ben (hiring mgr) re: comp band (15m) — agenda: target, leverage, relocation?
- 09:45 — update ATS notes for 6 screened candidates (Priya, Marcos, Lena, Omar, Sunita, Raj)
- 11:00 — Marcos L. panel (interview) — panel: Aaron (Eng), Jin (PM), me (coord)
- 13:00 — buffer for timezone scheduling (EMEA candidates)
- 14:00 — debrief with Eng lead: Priya take-home review
- 15:30 — follow-up emails / offer packet prep
- 16:30 — daily sync w/ People Ops team (standup)

Candidate follow-ups (quick notes):
- Priya R. — waiting on Eng lead review. If no feedback by 15:00 escalate to Aaron. Note: candidate asked about remote policy. Link to policy: Confluence: /display/HR/Remote+Policy
- Marcos L. — good technical screen, strong infra experience. Panel scheduled. Needs timezone confirmation (he's CET). Send invite with local time.
- Lena S. — scheduling 1:1 with hiring mgr (Ben) — propose Tue/Wed morning PT.
- Omar K. — references: 2 completed, 1 pending (former manager). Chase reference via email template (use template REF-2).
- Sunita P. — paperwork: background check initiated. Confirm DOB and current address before sending consent link.
- Raj N. — asked about relocation package. Add note for comp discussion.

Notes to self / TODOs (scratchy):
- Use updated Zoom link (company account) not personal. Replace old join link in all invites.
- Update interview kit doc with new scoring rubric v2. Link: Confluence Interview Guide (above).
- Remind hiring managers: keep to 45m panel windows; candidate buffer 15m between interviews.
- Re-run candidate shortlist export from ATS for EOY hiring review (filter: 'stage:onsite' + 'submitted:last30d').
- Clean up calendar for next week — consolidate interviews into blocks (Mon/Wed/Thu).

Blocked / waiting on:
- Eng lead feedback for Priya (BLOCK)
- Compensation approval for L5 PM band — finance check (Ben/Finance)

Templates / useful quick links:
- Offer template (HR-OFFER-L5) — draft in Google Drive (ask Legal for clause on equity).
- Reference email template: REF-2 (People Ops templates folder)
- Interview kit: Confluence Interview Guide (linked above)

Quick reminders (short):
- Do not schedule back-to-back >3 interviews for a candidate day-of.
- Confirm timezone label in invites (always include candidate timezone).
- For EMEA candidates, default to 9–12 PT windows for hiring mgrs.

End-of-day checklist:
- Sent follow-ups: Priya, Omar reference chase, Sunita background link
- Calendar invites created + verified (Zoom link, interviewer list)
- ATS updated for all moved candidates
- Note outstanding items for tomorrow

Random notes / scratch (might delete later):
- Candidate Marcos liked our blog post on "Serving at scale" — add to convo? nice icebreaker.
- Check with SRE scheduling rotation for potential interviewer availability next week.

-- Maya
